notes.title: Small Update to Address Anti-Virus False Positives
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've made a very small change to the game files that should help with the issues that people were having with their Anti-virus giving a false positive.

If you continue to get a false positive after this update, please contact us with information on what antivirus you are using.

Thank you!

notes.title: Palais de Reine - Chinese support added
notes.notes:
Dear pretender to the throne,

You can now enjoy the struggles of Filia in simplified and traditional Chinese.

Happy kingmaking!

notes.title: v1.04 additional tweaks
notes.notes:
The current Steam version of the game differs a bit from the original 2006 (non-Steam) release, in that a number of events involving alternate outfits and decorative items were removed during the upscaling process. However, some remnants of these events had previously slipped through the cracks, leaving incomplete pieces of content behind that were causing some confusion to players. These "content shards" have now been properly removed from the game.

A scant few events which previously required usage of these disabled outfits and decorative items have now also been retooled to be finishable without them.

In short: The game should no longer trigger any content that is unavailable, but nor should it refrain from triggering fully intact content due to unrelated events which are unavailable.

notes.title: v1.04 update
notes.notes: Another minor but very welcome update: the game will now properly ignore high DPI settings, preventing it from appearing zoomed-in if played with Windows magnification configured above 100%.

notes.title: v1.03 update
notes.notes: Just a small update: Debug mode was enabled for players by accident during the last pre-launch update. It has now been properly disabled.
